description.title: תנאי פוליסת מכלול
description.summary: This table outlines the conditions for reinstatement of damaged property under the 'מכלול' insurance policy. It details the insurer's options and the insured's responsibilities in the event of loss or damage.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת 'מכלול' מאפשרת למבטח, לפי שיקול דעתו, לשקם או להחליף רכוש שניזוק או הושמד, במקום לשלם את סכום האובדן או הנזק. במקרה שהמבטח בוחר לשקם או להחליף רכוש, המבוטח יספק למבטח תוכניות, מפרטים, מידות, כמויות וכל פרט אחר שהמבטח עשוי לדרוש. סעיף 24 מתאר את תהליך השיקום או ההחלפה.
description.column_axis: Details of reinstatement process and insured's obligations

sketch:
24. Reinstatement
24.1 The insurer may, at its discretion, reinstate or replace the damaged or destroyed property, or any part thereof, instead of paying the sum of the loss or damage, or will be entitled to participate with any other insurer or insurers in doing so.
24.2 In the event that the insurer chooses to reinstate or replace any property, the insured shall provide the insurer with the plans, specifications, measurements, quantities and all other details as the insurer may require, and none of the actions taken or caused to be taken by the insurer with the intention of reinstatement or replacement, shall be interpreted as the insurer's choice to reinstate or replace the damage.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת מכלול
This table outlines the conditions for reinstatement of damaged property under the 'מכלול' insurance policy. It details the insurer's options and the insured's responsibilities in the event of loss or damage.
ממדים: Reinstatement conditions / clauses, Details of reinstatement process and insured's obligations

24. Reinstatement
24.1 The insurer may, at its discretion, reinstate or replace the damaged or destroyed property, or any part thereof, instead of paying the sum of the loss or damage, or will be entitled to participate with any other insurer or insurers in doing so.
24.2 In the event that the insurer chooses to reinstate or replace any property, the insured shall provide the insurer with the plans, specifications, measurements, quantities and all other details as the insurer may require, and none of the actions taken or caused to be taken by the insurer with the intention of reinstatement or replacement, shall be interpreted as the insurer's choice to reinstate or replace the damage.
